label: Van Inwagen Précis1993 proposed life composition and event persistence criterion
paraphrase: In the Précis1993 proposed answer, collective activity composing a thing is equivalent to constituting a life, described as a special self-maintaining event admitting and expelling particles. Across two times at which collective activity constitutes lives, the composed objects are identical iff those lives are the same event. The Précis allows indeterminacy about life-event identity and whether activity constitutes a life. This states the author proposal, not its truth or an operational biological definition.
